entries.title: 2017 Asia Clean Energy Forum, Manila (34966560462).jpg
entries.description: USAID/Pakistan​'s incoming​ ​M​ission ​D​irector Jerry Bisson co-opened the Asia Clean Energy Forum (ACEF) at the Asian Development Bank headquarters in Manila, Philippines today on June 6, 2017. Along with the Asian Development Bank and the Korea Energy Agency, USAID is supporting the twelfth ACEF which will bring together over 1,500 participants from over 60 countries. Over 2.5 days of plenary and breakout sessions and 1.5 days of deep-dive workshops, ACEF provides governments, business, and academia with the latest developments and key issues in Asia’s clean energy sector through targeted and in-depth discussion sessions.
entries.creator: USAID Pakistan

taken.title: 169th Fighter Wing honors South Carolina healthcare professionals (49828978298).jpg
taken.description: U.S. Air Force Lt. Col. Jeffrey Beckham, an F-16 fighter pilot, assigned to the South Carolina Air National Guard’s 169th Fighter Wing, taxis his F-16 prior to takeoff at McEntire Joint National Guard Base, S.C., April 27, 2020. The 169th Fighter Wing saluted the healthcare professionals in South Carolina with a statewide flyover of more than 60 hospitals. The series of flyovers, originating from McEntire Joint National Guard Base, South Carolina, is part of the U.S. Air Force’s Operation AMERICAN RESOLVE to show appreciation to the thousands of heroes on the front lines battling COVID-19 with the intent to lift morale in cities across America. (U.S. Air National Guard photo by Capt. Stephen Hudson, 169th Fighter Wing Public Affairs)
taken.creator: S.C. Air National Guard

taken.title: Bangladesh Sri Lanka MoU Training Nurses Healthcare Professionals 2021-03-20 (PID-0030124).jpg
taken.description: At the Prime Minister's Office, a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) was signed concerning Bangladesh's assistance in training nurses and healthcare professionals in Sri Lanka. The signing took place in the presence of Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina and Sri Lankan Prime Minister Mahinda Rajapaksa. The MoU was signed by Health Minister Zahid Maleque representing Bangladesh, and Ajith Nivard Cabraal, State Minister of Money and Capital Market and State Enterprise Reforms of Sri Lanka.
